info.title: Cassava Leaf Disease Classification
info.subtitle: Image Dataset from Directory Format of Cassava Leaf Disease Dataset
info.description:
This dataset comprises five distinct folders, each representing a specific disease affecting cassava plants:

1. /Cassava___bacterial_blight
1. /Cassava___brown_streak_disease
1. /Cassava___green_mottle
1. /Cassava___mosaic_disease
1. /Cassava___healthy

All images are organized within these five folders, eliminating the need for additional train/test directories. This simplified structure facilitates ease of access and utilization.

The challenge posed by this dataset involves leveraging relatively inexpensive camera-captured photos to identify problems with cassava plants. Participants are tasked with distinguishing between various diseases that pose a significant threat to the food supply in several African countries. The urgency of addressing these issues is underscored by the fact that, in certain instances, the primary solution involves promptly identifying and isolating infected plants through measures such as burning to prevent further spread. Automated solutions are crucial to expedite this process and prove beneficial to farmers.

dataset source: https://www.kaggle.com/competitions/cassava-leaf-disease-classification
